modmenu.descriptionTranslation.networkpr: A Minecraft mod with support for HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies and per-server proxy configuration.
config.networkproxy.title: Network Proxy Settings
config.networkproxy.use_for_downloads: Use proxy for web downloads (like resourcepacks)
config.networkproxy.use_filter.tooltip: Use a direct connection for multiplayer addresses without an entry.
config.networkproxy.socks5_remote_dns.to: Let SOCKS5 resolve multiplayer server names. Minecraft skips its local DNS and SRV lookups for these servers.
config.networkproxy.invalid_proxy_host: Enter a hostname or IP address. Set the port separately.
config.networkproxy.server_address.toolt: Enter a hostname or IP address. Add a port to match only that port.
config.networkproxy.server_address.legac: This imported rule matches the domain and its subdomains. Changing the address switches to exact matching.
config.networkproxy.invalid_address: Enter a valid hostname or IP address, with an optional port.
config.networkproxy.duplicate_address: This server address is already configured.
